title: How to evaluate a Shopify room visualiser
description: Evaluate a room visualiser against your actual product pages, your customers’ likely photos and the questions they need answered. Check appearance, theme.
answer: Evaluate a room visualiser against your actual product pages, your customers’ likely photos and the questions they need answered. Check appearance, theme integration, privacy, billing and the distinction between illustrative placement and measurement.
body:
Make the evaluation repeatable

Choose representative products, photos, devices and templates before comparing tools. Use the same inputs where permitted and record limitations as well as successful results.

A practical review checklist

  • Check input requirements and output limitations.
  • Check your actual Shopify templates and mobile layout.
  • Read current privacy and billing information.
  • Use a realistic usage estimate and account for extra previews.

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Use the app’s documented workflow

Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.

Start with setup instructions, inspect the current product examples, and check plans and usage charges. Ask support about your specific store before treating an assumption as a product feature.
